supersedes.for: every stage not yet run under v1: the RTX6000PRO / H100 gates, prepare and TEST

accepted_v1_l40s_gate_records.basis: identical L40S evaluator and bitwise criterion (delta review)

permits: reading the 134 BF/SHG TEST cores (their raw members once in the prepare job, then the locked prepared inputs) solely to evaluate the frozen selected checkpoints of the manifest with the frozen evaluators
conditions: inside a Slurm GPU job submitted with V10_TR_EXPECT_ACTIVATION = sha256 of this file and V10_TR_EXPECT_COMMIT = the v2 execution worktree commit; the records, the code files above and the bundle copies are byte-identical
prepare: every L40S DEV gate PASS (v1 records of a85cc21b accepted); raw member sha256 == the manifest; prepared arrays == V9-G1's prepared cache

test: the (family, GPU type) DEV gate PASS (L40S) or PASS / PASS_TOLERANCE (RTX6000PRO, H100); the job's GPU type == the unit's recorded DEV32 GPU type; INPUT_LOCK PASS under this activation; frozen checkpoint sha256 == the manifest
results are written once and never overwritten; every TEST read is logged
forbidden: any TEST access outside these jobs (login node, CPU tests, interactive use)
training, CAL selection, checkpoint choice, grid / candidate / protocol changes from TEST content
pooling TEST_REPEAT with DEV or calling it an independent confirmation
re-running a unit to replace a result
